# KiloMail

> Disposable email service with real-time SSE inboxes. Free public API — no API key, no sign-up, no rate limits, 30-day message retention.

Base URL: https://kilomail.tech (also served on https://kilomail.vercel.app)
Own domains: factoryai.tech, kilomail.my.id, kilosms.web.id, kilomail.tech

Important notes:

- Every endpoint is free and unauthenticated — no API key, no token, no quota, no rate limiting
- Own domains are served by /api/inbox/*; third-party inboxes (guerrillamail, maildrop, tempmailplus, tempmailio) are served by /api/providers/<id>?action=…
- Both return the same JSON shapes: MessageMeta for lists, MessageFull for a single message
- Inboxes keep mail for 30 days, max 50 messages per inbox; expired messages are deleted automatically
- Browsers may call the API directly — responses carry Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *
- Built on Vercel Edge Functions, Upstash Redis, and Cloudflare Email Routing + Workers
- Open source under MIT license

## API

- [Public API reference](https://kilomail.tech/#/docs): Every endpoint, params, responses and curl examples
- GET /api/inbox/{email}: list messages in an inbox (MessageMeta[])
- GET /api/inbox/{email}/stream: Server-Sent Events live inbox stream
- GET /api/inbox/{email}/{id}: full message body (MessageFull)
- DELETE /api/inbox/{email}/{id}: delete one message
- GET /api/providers/{provider}?action=inbox&email={email}: third-party inbox list
- GET /api/providers/{provider}?action=read&email={email}&id={id}: third-party message body
- POST /api/providers/{provider}?action=create: create a provider-issued address
